shortDescription: The Ravens option in Polymarket's Saints vs. Ravens submarket "1H Spread -21.5" surged from 6% an hour earlier to 47%, according to Catcher Predict monitoring. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 41 percentage point swing and may have been influenced by breaking news.
